name: Noche en el Delirio
source:
A series of murders puts a town in Chile on alert and the police are unable to identify the perpetrator and his strange messages. Meanwhile, Nicolas, the young owner of the Delirio bar, suspects that the culprit is hiding among his frequent customers.

[From [url=https://bardelirio.itch.io/noche-en-el-delirio]Itch.io[/url]]
